description: tools.list with source=mcp: the MCP half of the catalog, which is NOT in the `tool` table at all (TC4) and so carries no seeded `version` (0) and no `rowCurrent` claim of its own beyond the server it came from. `acme.post` is MC6 made visible — a declared tool nobody classified, `classified:false`, `available:true` because it is a real tool of a real enabled server, and `effect:outward` with `rerunClass:unsafe`; hiding it would let the management screen pretend an outward-facing capability is absent while its server still advertises it. `description` is EMPTY because no authority holds one (S46's `mcp_server_tool` records name, rerun and effect): an invented sentence would be the catalog authoring a contract it cannot enforce. Both belong to the enabled `acme` server; the disabled `off` server's `sleep` is nowhere, because a tool of a disabled server cannot be called by anyone.
